verdict.rationale: YYLO Skills publishes its own Claude plugin marketplace manifest (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json) that lists its skill set. Its README documents an interactive install flow where users type letters to narrow skill choices, which gives a glancing way to see available skills before installing. Much of the interactive browsing comes from the external open `skills` CLI rather than the product itself, and there is no searchable registry or leaderboard. Missing for 10: a documented browsable/searchable catalog or registry, skill-detail listings viewable before install, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can browse or search a catalog of available skills — a registry, leaderboard, or marketplace listing — before installing anything
